rule: The swastika pair changes by a mirror (left-right) flip, so the arrow should be mirrored: head and tail swap sides. A true mirror of the U-arrow (head upper-left, wide shaded tail upper-right) is not drawn; every option has the same turning direction (counter-clockwise from tail to head) as the given figure, so all are rotations of it. Option 5, with head on the left and the shaded tail on the right, is the closest to the mirrored arrow.
options_check: 1: identical to the given arrow, no change, rejected. 2: given arrow rotated 180 degrees (head lower-left, tail right); same turning direction, a rotation not a mirror, but head-left/tail-right. 3: given arrow rotated about 90 degrees clockwise (opens right, tail top, head bottom-right); head on the right, rejected. 4: similar to 3 but rotated about 60 degrees; head on the right, rejected. 5: opens left, head at top-left pointing left, shaded tail at bottom-right; head left/tail right as in a mirror, best available.
redraw_diffs: Redraw matches the original in layout and in the swastika pair and arrow. Minor differences: option 4 head points more down-right in the redraw and the twisted-ribbon crossings and shading are simplified, option 3 head is slightly different in angle. None of these change the turning direction, so they do not change the answer.
